ModMetaData.name: Alert!
ModMetaData.author: Cruesoe
ModMetaData.description:
One key switches your colony between normal and alert status.
Each status remembers its own settings for every colonist: allowed area, schedule, work priorities, apparel, food, drug and reading policies, and hostility response. Tame animals' allowed areas are remembered too. There's nothing to set up: press the key, arrange your colonists the way you want them during a raid, and press it again to put everything back. Next time, one press brings the alert settings back.
While alert status is on, a red border and an ALERT banner stay on screen. Click the banner to return to normal.
The default key is F9. Change it in Options -> Controls -> Keyboard Configuration: Modify -> In-game global -> Toggle alert status. What switches, the border and the sound can be changed in the mod settings.
Safe to add to an existing save. Return to normal before removing the mod, or colonists keep their alert settings.
